routine_definition:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT lower(trim(coalesce(query_text, ''))) AS qtext
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    s.service,
    CASE
      WHEN i.qtext = lower(s.service) THEN 3
      WHEN length(i.qtext) >= 3 AND s.term_kind = 'service name'
           AND (lower(s.service) LIKE concat(i.qtext, '%') OR s.term LIKE concat(i.qtext, '%')) THEN 2
      WHEN i.qtext RLIKE concat('(^|[^a-z0-9])', s.term, '([^a-z0-9]|$)') THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS score,
    CASE
      WHEN i.qtext = lower(s.service) THEN lower(s.service)
      WHEN length(i.qtext) >= 3 AND s.term_kind = 'service name' AND lower(s.service) LIKE concat(i.qtext, '%') THEN lower(s.service)
      WHEN length(i.qtext) >= 3 AND s.term_kind = 'service name' AND s.term LIKE concat(i.qtext, '%') THEN s.term
      WHEN i.qtext RLIKE concat('(^|[^a-z0-9])', s.term, '([^a-z0-9]|$)') THEN s.term
    END AS hit_label
  FROM workspace.carematch.service_synonyms s
  CROSS JOIN input i
),
per_service AS (
  SELECT service, max(score) AS score,
         array_join(array_sort(collect_set(hit_label)), ', ') AS matched_terms
  FROM scored
  GROUP BY service
  HAVING max(score) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, rank() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk FROM per_service
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    count_if(rnk = 1)                                   AS n_top,
    max(score)                                          AS top_score,
    max_by(service, score)                              AS top_service,
    max_by(matched_terms, score)                        AS top_terms,
    array_join(array_sort(collect_list(service)), ', ') AS all_candidates
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  i.qtext AS input_text,
  CASE WHEN s.n_top = 1 THEN s.top_service END AS resolved_service,
  CASE
    WHEN i.qtext = ''             THEN 'Type a service name or describe the care needed'
    WHEN coalesce(s.n_top, 0) = 0 THEN 'No supported service matched'
    WHEN s.n_top > 1              THEN 'Ambiguous: matches several services, please refine'
    WHEN s.top_score = 3          THEN 'Exact service name'
    WHEN s.top_score = 2          THEN 'Autocomplete match'
    ELSE 'Suggested from description (not a diagnosis)'
  END AS resolution_status,
  CASE WHEN s.n_top = 1 THEN s.top_terms END AS matched_terms,
  s.all_candidates
FROM input i
CROSS JOIN summary s
